acceptance_criteria: A test with an inventory whose facts leave zero target capacity yields a report with 0 assessments, all subjects omitted and no exception.
A test with a valid 64-advisory catalog using 2048-byte source URLs yields a report under 1 MiB with omitted subjects instead of an exception.
AdvisoryCatalog tests reject catalogs over the distinct-source and catalog-fact caps and accept the bundled catalog; a test at the cap produces a report within 256 sources.

A test with an unpackaged FPM container (container fixture) plus 15 identical child workers assesses the CLI with the bundled catalog and omits only identical children; a deleted or differently-pathed worker still keeps rank 0.
Bundled catalog on existing fixtures: unchanged assessment counts (no new omissions).
goal: Issue #38 / PR #46 CodeRabbit Majors: a valid catalog plus a bounded inventory must always produce a report (with blocked advisory.assessment-budget coverage for what does not fit) instead of RuntimeAuditReportBuilder throwing, and ordinary unpackaged containers must not lose the CLI to the PRA-14 budget drop. (1) Zero target budget: targetBudget may return 0, every target is then reported as omitted, the report keeps catalog facts only. (2) Byte budget: admitted targets are limited so the encoded report stays within EvidenceValidator::MAX_INPUT_BYTES, measured or conservatively estimated from the actual advisory output (source URL lengths, rationale cap), dropping lowest-ranked targets first and keeping all targets when the report fits. (3) Sources: AdvisoryCatalog rejects at load time catalogs whose distinct source URLs (main, mitigation and vendor-rule) or catalog-level facts exceed caps sized so that catalog sources/facts plus the collector's maximum inventory sources/facts stay within the 256-source and 1024-fact schema limits; vendor-rule sources added per matched target are counted in the target budget. The source schema guard in the builder stays. (4) Unpackaged identical workers: non-deleted workers with the same kind, executable/module path, version and provenance result rank as identical children (rank 3) like packaged ones, so php:*-fpm/apache containers with many workers keep the CLI assessed.
non_goals: No verdict, patch-status or exposure logic changes; no catalog data changes; no affected-branch modelling for 8.5-only/8.4+-only CVEs (separate follow-up).
